headline: Last session: Nifty gained 75 points while Sensex slipped into red after CAS; smallcaps showed resilience.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.

why: Sensex slipped into the red following the CAS announcement in the previous session.
Nifty 50 managed to gain 75 points despite volatility in the broader market.
Smallcap stocks provided a cushion to the indices during the last trading day.
Concerns over a 15% monsoon deficit and El Nino risks impacted agricultural sentiment.
whatHappening: NTPC has terminated a 400 MWh BESS contract previously awarded to G R Infraprojects.
DLF is planning to open a 500 crore mall in Goa by March 2027.
Paytm remained in focus as traders assessed opening trends and market volatility.
Investors are shifting focus to the upcoming trading week starting September 21-25.

summary:
The Indian market ended the last session with mixed results as Nifty gained 75 points while the Sensex closed in the red. 
Corporate developments saw NTPC terminate a major contract with G R Infraprojects, while DLF announced expansion plans in Goa. 
Trading is currently suspended for the weekend, with the next session scheduled for Tuesday, 22 September.
